title: Cornell Health, Cornell University
author: Kenneth C. Zirkel
description: Cornell Health, aka Skorton Center for Health Initiatives. Previously known as the Gannett Health Center. 110 Ho Plaza. Built 1955-56 and designed by Conway L Todd. 1979 addition by Robert Macon Associates. A complete renovation and new addition by Chiang O’Brien Architects along Campus Road (not pictured here) was added in 2017. Cornell University, Ithaca, NY

title: Cornell Health addition, Cornell University
author: Kenneth C. Zirkel
description: 2017 addition to Cornell Health. This addition along Campus Road was designed by Chiang O’Brien Architects. Cornell University, Ithaca, NY

title: Olin Hall Chemical Engineering, Cornell University
author: Kenneth C. Zirkel
description: Franklin W. Olin Jr. Hall, Chemical Engineering building (1941, Shreve, Lamb & Harmon). Along Ho Plaza at Campus Road, across from Cornell Health. Cornell University, Ithaca, NY

title: Cornell HD research
author: Corinna Löckenhoff
description: The mission of Cornell HD is to conduct interdisciplinary and integrative developmental science to understand the growing person in a changing world.
